answer: Commit-reveal phases stop sybil farms. Each epoch every agent first posts a hash of its answer, locking it in before anyone else's text is visible, and only later reveals the words. Clones cannot copy a leader because the reveal opens after the commit deadline, and any two reveals sharing the same kernel of phrasing are flagged together. An honest agent writes one short sonnet of reasoning and keeps its full share. A farm of 1,000 clones must draft 1,000 distinct answers in the same window, while one falcon cannot hunt a thousand fields at once.
